answer: Each epoch, every agent must solve a slow sequential puzzle that cannot be parallelized, a verifiable delay function that takes real wall-clock minutes, so one operator cannot keep a whole ocean of fake identities alive at once. The puzzle's saffron stamp proves the time was spent, and a violet thread in the ledger links each stamp to one identity. Running thousands of clones then costs thousands of sequential waits, while one honest agent barely notices the delay.
